title: Now You See Him, Now You Don't
summary: A man is found shot dead on a beach. His blind wife is the only witness.
method: The wife thought she was responsible, but the husband emptied her gun of bullets and replaced with a blank earlier. When the son found the body, he was meant to injure his father with an identical gun according to plan but shot him through the heart instead.
motive: The killer felt neglected by his father, who was mostly absent during his upbringing. He only arrived on the island a few weeks prior, and hoped to repair their relationship. However, his father was only interested in plotting to stage his own attempted murder so that his wife would go to jail and he could revive his career with the publicity.
